studies.title: The chasqui relay runners
studies.caption: Runners wait in pairs at posts a few kilometres apart along the royal roads, passing on spoken messages and knotted khipu at a run.
studies.prompt: Side view at ground level of two Inca chasqui runners exchanging a small knotted khipu beside a simple roadside shelter on a stone path above Cusco around1500. One runner arriving, the other turning to depart, feet clearly on the PATH, no bridge. Woven knee-length tunics, sandals and small satchels; distant Andean terraces. Focus gesture, knotted cords and motion, no horses, wheels, alphabet scroll or Spanish colonial building.
